measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/w_sqknest.mdl, models/w_egon.mdl, models/w_crowbar.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked D, D, B, A where the asset was C, B, A, C: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: In all ten views the outline reads as a pump-action shotgun: a long barrel, a dark receiver, a wooden pump under the barrel and a wooden stock at the rear, with the stock's heel flaring out in the top and below views. Nothing sticks out or is missing. The stock's hook is judged under M3.

M2.reason: Measured size is 13.7 x 1.2 x 28.3 units against the brief's 30 long, an offset of 0.058, well within 15%.

M3.reason: The brief names a pump (present, wooden, under the receiver), black metal (present) and a folding stock whose end hooks over. The stock is a straight wooden slab whose heel is only bevelled outward (top view, bottom-left of the stock; below view, top). That is not clearly a hook. No fold joint is visible where the stock meets the receiver in the side views (LEFT, RIGHT, TOP). The named hooked, folding stock is therefore not clearly there, which caps M3 at 1. The pump, barrel and receiver are all present.

M4.reason: Black or dark blue-grey metal on the barrel and receiver, and warm wood on the stock and pump, as the brief asks. No region reads as the wrong material or colour.

M5.reason: The brief asks for no particular markings. The wood has grain, the receiver has some ridged and vented detail (first-person view, left), and nothing is smeared or wrong.

M6.reason: Capped by the line-up test, as the rubric says. Across the four readings the judges picked D, D, B and A, and the asset (C, B, A, C in those orders) was never picked as the one not made by Valve. In the line-up it reads as a Valve model.

M7.reason: The muzzle is at one end and the stock at the other, and the gun lies on its side in the LEFT, RIGHT and front-left views with nothing floating. I could not check the front against a Valve shotgun, because none is in the line-up and the brief gives no front.

M8.reason: The SMAK check reports no errors. Triangles are 132 against Valve's median of 138, well under twice that. No open, inverted or floating geometry shows in any view.

W1.reason: In the first-person view (left picture) the receiver sits at about x 280 to 430 of its half, the same place as the game's own shotgun (about x 280 to 420 of its half). The orange hand sits under the forend at the same place as in the game's own, and the gun has the same way round. Through the attack frames the hands stay on the gun and the gun does not part from them where both are shown. The frames are partly cropped at the bottom.
